meta.name: deck-blueprint
meta.description: 奶油纸 + 锈红 + 蓝图网格 mask + 黑边硬卡片 + pipeline 盒

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为卡片添加复古蓝图风格的装饰效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在设计中加入蓝图网格和锈红奶油色调的卡片元素。
copy.tagline_en: Add retro blueprint-style decorative effects to cards.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add blueprint grid and rust-red cream tones to card designs.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 排版幻灯片时采用“蓝图架构”风格：奶油色底、蓝图网格、锈红重点标注、黑边硬卡片和 pipeline 步骤盒，整体无渐变、无软阴影。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作架构讲解或 pipeline 流程的幻灯片时触发。

say.text: 把这段架构做成蓝图风格的 deck
say.note: 生成 16:9 的架构幻灯片

say.text: 帮我画一个 pipeline 流程，其中一个步骤要抬高
say.note: 会生成带步骤盒的流程页
关键信息会标成锈红 callout

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude formats slides in the Blueprint style: cream background, blueprint grid, rust-red highlights, hard black-bordered cards, and pipeline step boxes, without gradients or soft shadows.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask for architecture walkthrough or pipeline flow slides.

say_en.text: Make this architecture a blueprint-style deck
Draw a pipeline flow with one step raised

say_en.text: Highlight this point in rust red
say_en.note: Key info appears as a rust callout
